# infrawrench_change_freeze (Resource)

A window during which writes to cloud resources are refused — the Black Friday freeze, the week of the audit — and scheduled power transitions are skipped rather than queued.

The natural way to use this from Terraform is a planned freeze committed ahead of time: the window is in the repository, with a reason and a reviewer, before the week it covers.

Ending a freeze **early** is an action on the API rather than an edit here — see `active`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, 1–120 characters. Shown to whoever is refused a write.

### Optional

- `ends_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp the freeze ends. Omit it for an open-ended freeze that runs until somebody ends it. Must be after `starts_at`.
- `reason` (String) Why the freeze exists, up to 2000 characters. Also shown on refusal.
- `starts_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp the freeze begins. Omit it to start immediately on creation — the server stamps `now`, which is why this is Computed.

Note the asymmetry in the API: on an update an omitted start leaves the stored one alone, while an omitted `reason` or `ends_at` clears it. That is the server's behaviour, and it is what makes a freeze that started an hour ago safe to edit.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the freeze is in effect. Operational state rather than configuration: ending a freeze early is a `POST …/end` on the API, and this attribute reports the outcome rather than driving it. A freeze ended early keeps its row, so it stays under Terraform's management and reads back as `false`.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned freeze id. Use it with `terraform import`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is in the URL when you open the object in the app, and in the
# --json output of the Infrawrench CLI.
terraform import infrawrench_change_freeze.example 2a3b4c5d-6e7f-8a9b-0c1d-2e3f4a5b6c7d
```
